name: seanime-denshi-mobile-android
description: Seaserver Denshi Mobile - the Android (APK) shell of the Denshi Mobile client: a Capacitor wrapper around the seanime-web mobile build that hot-swaps in newer frontend bundles published to the server.

scripts.build:apk: node scripts/build-www.mjs && cap sync android && cd android && gradlew.bat assembleDebug
scripts.build:apk:release: node scripts/build-www.mjs && cap sync android && cd android && gradlew.bat assembleRelease
